steps.description: The hands lift the drill and slide the battery pack off its base and set it on the bench.
steps.done_when: the drill is de-energized with the power source separated and set aside
steps.title: Disconnect the drill from power

steps.description: The hands twist the chuck open and pull the old bit out and lay it on the bench.
steps.done_when: the chuck is empty and the old bit is set aside on the bench
steps.title: Remove the old drill bit

steps.description: The hands open the bit case, select a new bit, place it in the chuck and twist the chuck tight.
steps.done_when: the replacement bit is centered in the chuck and the chuck is tightened
steps.title: Insert the new drill bit

steps.description: The hands pick up the battery pack and slide it onto the drill base until seated.
steps.done_when: the drill is re-energized with the power source firmly seated
steps.title: Reconnect the drill to power

steps.description: The hands hold the drill, run it briefly to spin the new bit, then set it down on the bench.
steps.done_when: the drill spins correctly and is left resting on the bench
steps.title: Test the drill

task_summary: Change the drill bit on a cordless electric drill with safe power disconnect, bit swap, reconnect, and operational test.
